_meta.prepared_for: Souveno AI (souveno.ai / souveno.in) — WhatsApp quote-to-cash and agentic automation for quote-heavy Indian B2B manufacturers & distributors

home_base.travel_preference: Founder prefers international (Gulf) trips; HYD-DXB is a 4-hour direct with 6+ daily flights, so Gulf geography scores 5/10 (cost) rather than 3.
home_base.departure_rule: ALL flights depart from and return to Hyderabad (HYD). No multi-city routings from another show's city.

icp_segments.D: Auto parts / auto ancillary / job work
icp_segments.P: Pipes / HDPE / PVC / ducts (flagship live client vertical)
icp_segments.F: Factories & plants: workforce attendance/performance, line activity, safety
icp_segments.W: Warehouses, 3PL & distribution hubs: stock count, dispatch verification, vehicle gates
icp_segments.K: Construction sites & developers: workforce, vehicle entry/exit, safety compliance
icp_segments.L: Logistics yards, fleets, gate operations: vehicle entry/exit, dwell time
icp_segments.R: Retail, cafés, showrooms: footfall, queue, staff activity
icp_segments.S: Security system integrators & CCTV dealers: Vision AI channel partners

scoring.icp_fit: 0-40  the BETTER of quote-desk fit and vision_fit (Vision AI buyers); the card says which product to lead with
scoring.competition_noise: 0-10  fewer WhatsApp/CRM SaaS vendors on the floor = higher
scoring.timing_fit: 0-10  fit with the 90-day plan, clashes, travel fatigue
scoring.stars: total/20 rounded to nearest 0.5, floor 1, cap 5
scoring.note: All component scores are the agent's estimates from public data plus Souveno's own ICP documents. Footfall figures are organiser claims unless marked 'audited'.

funnel_assumptions.source: Barakah Systems validation report targets: >=30% of qualified demos accept a paid pilot

flight_policy.note: book >= 30 days before departure (>= 45 international); 60/90 days when time permits

product_lines.quote_desk: WhatsApp AI quote desk: enquiry → stock → GST quotation PDF → payment (ICP segments A-E, P)
product_lines.vision_ai: Vision AI: camera-based employee attendance & performance reports, stock and dispatch counting, vehicle entry/exit logging, safety (segments F, W, K, L, R)

deal_economics.note: Editable assumptions for the Finance tab. First-year value per paid pilot that converts; change here and every P&L recomputes.

quote_desk.label: WhatsApp quote desk: ₹25,000 pilot + Growth plan ₹12,000/month

vision_ai.label: Vision AI: ₹50,000 pilot + ₹25,000/month per site (cameras already on site)

both.label: Mixed floor: average of the two products

deal_economics.lead_to_client_note: qualified 35% × demo 50% × paid pilot 30% = 5.25% of captured leads become paying clients

contact_policy.company_email_used_for: stall bookings, organiser correspondence, invoices, subsidies, exhibitor registrations
contact_policy.travel_email_used_for: flights, hotels, e-tickets, booking confirmations, visa
contact_policy.payment: Souveno current account (net banking / NEFT / its debit card) for everything, in both modes
